identity: Compared with twelve point, L/F/M are wider in both 1897 and census specimens while other capitals are not uniformly wider. Compared with seven point, figures 0/3/5/6/8/9 are broader in 1897, corroborated by document figures 3/5/6/8; six-point T is narrower relative to cap height. These recurring proportions support a distinct optical cut.
visual_review: All 37 visible native crops and final silhouettes inspected at 185 and 32 pixels; words inspected at 16/24/40/64/96 pixels. All intended bowls, serifs, arms, figure beaks and tails retained. Four trial proofs, seven threshold sheets and the full cross-book native comparisons reviewed.
source_choices: All capitals and figures use census six-point impressions; the period is doc6-43. The census provides finer detail than the upper 1897 row and avoids uneven job-room ink spread. The period is explicitly printed in labelled six-point document text. All four source books are retained.
rejected_trials: The initial capital threshold 200 and figure threshold 215 included excess scan fringe. Individually reviewed capital thresholds 175/185/195 better preserve the native light strokes.
Census figure 8 at threshold 195 loses the lower bowl join despite appearing closed in small renderings; threshold 205 retains both observed counters.

Extrapolating the alphabet baseline across a 1230-pixel gap raised the figures by about six native pixels. The local baseline measured from 1/4/7 replaces this extrapolation while retaining the same physical scale.
Threshold 165 loses the K arm, Y branches, Q/R bowls and several figure parts. Threshold 185 still loses the figure 1 beak, 2 foot, 4 arm and 6/8/9 joins.
geometry: Uniform measured cap scale and rigid source-row rotations. The separate figure group uses a local baseline and rotation measured from 1/4/7 at the same physical scale. No hole filling, drawn missing strokes or cross-size substitution.
native_limitations: The small native six-point impressions retain minor print irregularities. Source proportions and visible completeness were verified without drawing idealized substitutes.

card_addition.reason: Thresholds175–195 lose the faint descending tail;205 retains its length but flattens its left curve. Threshold215 retains the observed head, left indentation and complete tail;225 adds soft fringe.
card_addition.period_comparison: The two card periods do not improve the clearer document-period source, which remains exact.
card_addition.visual_review: Native size and construction proofs, six threshold alternatives, and words at16/24/40/64/96pixels inspected.
